title: Classroom of the Elite Season 5 Announces 2027 Premiere Date
content: It was announced at the MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival event that Classroom of the Elite Season 5 is set to premiere in 2027. A teaser visual and trailer were also released. Season 5 was officially announced immediately after the fourth season’s finale premiered.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 5th Season: 2-nensei-hen 2 Gakki' Airs in 2027
content: The MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2026 revealed cast members, main staff, and a teaser visual (pictured) for Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 5th Season: 2-nensei-hen 2 Gakki ( Classroom of the Elite 5th Season: Second Year, Second Semester ) on Sunday.

title: Solo Leveling’s Biggest Competitor Is Making a Huge Comeback Ahead of Anime Premiere
content: There’s no denying that Solo Leveling is the most popular and influential webtoon and light novel series of all time. It also paved the path for the entire medium’s success across the globe, encouraging more animation studios to release webtoon adaptations.

title: Mawaru Penguindrum Anime Inspires Stage Reading Production by Kunihiko Ikuhara
content: Revolutionary Girl Utena director Kunihiko Ikuhara announced on Friday that he is writing and serving as chief director on Ikuni Produce Reading in the dark: Kodomo Broiler Sensō (Ikuni Produce Reading in the dark: Child Broiler War), a brand-new stage reading production inspired by his Penguindrum anime.
author: ANN

title: 3 Female Anime Leads of 2026 Who Are Breaking the Male-Dominated Industry
content: The anime industry has arguably long been accused of being male-dominated, largely thanks to the success of numerous shonen anime that established the boy-oriented genre as a leading force in entertainment.

title: Yu Yu Hakusho Needs a Modern Anime Revival for One Main Reason
content: In recent years, there’s been a massive uptick in classic anime series receiving new-and-improved reboots that aim to deliver modern animation , stories that stay more closely aligned to the story’s original source material, and even new vocal performances from legacy cast members.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Producers Confirm These Missing Bending Styles Still Exist
content: Avatar: Seven Havens has ended its first season without some key bending styles seen in action, and thankfully the producers behind it all teases the ones missing in action still exist in the future of the series.

title: New Star Wars Series Creator Reveals How Lucasfilm “Got Angry” Over Creative Control
content: Star Wars made its full anime series debut with a major Star Wars: Visions spin off hitting earlier this Summer, and the creator behind it revealed how there were some surprising complications when developing the series under Lucasfilm.
